claims.text: Hurley stage III: secukinumab or bimekizumab are efficacious alternatives to infliximab (as is adalimumab)
claims.quote: For Hurley Stage III disease, medical and surgical therapy should be more aggressive (2). Evidence of efficacy in reducing inflammation is strongest for infliximab (3). Alternatively, adalimumab, secukinumab, or bimekizumab are also efficacious (4, 5, 6).
